_comment: Night 10-15 events: false memories, memory overload, complex merges, layered contextual rules, mastery-level decisions.

events.title: New Mushrooms — Similar, but Different
events.description: Pale mushrooms. But these have a slightly different shape: the cap is flatter, the stem thicker. Otherwise they look nearly identical to the ones you've eaten safely before.

cues.description: Pale mushrooms — similar to known edible ones, but cap shape is slightly different
Slightly more pungent than the edible ones you remember
Growing in a different spot — damper ground, near water

outcome.description: These are NOT the same. Within hours, severe nausea. You've confused two similar-looking species. A dangerous overgeneralization.

memory_reward.title: Toxic Lookalike Mushrooms
memory_reward.description: Almost identical to edible ones but toxic. Flat cap, thick stem, growing near water. Dangerous overgeneralization nearly killed me.

cue_tags.description: flat cap (different from rounded edible ones)
more pungent smell than edible variety
growing near water, not in dry forest

choices.text: Look more carefully — something is slightly different

outcome.description: You notice: flatter cap, different stem, wetter ground. Not the same species. You leave them. Refinement of a memory prevents a serious mistake.

memory_reward.title: Mushroom Lookalikes
memory_reward.description: Not all pale spotted mushrooms are the same. Context matters: location, cap shape, smell all distinguish edible from toxic.
traits: similar appearance can be different species

events.title: Wolves at the Firelight
events.description: Night camp. Your small fire crackles. In the trees, you hear howling — but the wolves don't approach. They circle at the edge of the light, watching.

cues.description: Eyes reflecting firelight at the tree line
Wolves approach the light then pull back

choices.text: Keep the fire burning and stay close to it

outcome.description: The fire holds. All night, the wolves pace the perimeter but never enter the light. By dawn they're gone. Fire repels wolves. A crucial multi-cue connection.

memory_reward.title: Fire Repels Wolves
memory_reward.description: Wolves approached firelight but would not enter it. Fire = protection from wolves at night.

choices.text: Let the fire die — save fuel

outcome.description: When the embers fade, the wolves move in. In darkness, they're far more confident. You climb a tree barely in time. Freezing and frightened all night.

memory_reward.title: Fire Protects at Night
memory_reward.description: Extinguished fire = wolves entered camp immediately. Fire is critical at night in wolf territory.

events.title: Bears — With Cubs
events.description: A bear. But not alone. Two small cubs tumble around her feet. She is between you and the path forward. Her ears are flat. Her posture is rigid.

cues.description: Mother bear with two cubs — ears flat, rigid posture
Cubs playing — mother is in protective mode
Strong musky odor, more intense than usual

choices.text: Extreme caution — back away immediately without any sound

outcome.description: A bear with cubs is categorically more dangerous. You back away in complete silence. Your understanding saves you — this situation needed a different response than a lone bear.

memory_reward.title: Mother Bear + Cubs
memory_reward.description: Bear with cubs = extreme danger regardless of normal safety rules. Completely silent retreat required. Standard rules don't apply.

outcome.description: You apply the usual rule — back away slowly, keep eye contact. But this isn't the usual situation. With cubs present, the mother charges immediately. Severe injuries.

memory_reward.title: Bears with Cubs (Wrong Response)
memory_reward.description: Used slow retreat on mother bear with cubs — she charged immediately. Mother bears require different rules: faster retreat, no eye contact.

events.title: Too Much at Once
events.description: A complex scene: smoke in the trees, a buzzing hollow ahead, claw marks on the bark to your left, and the light is fading. Multiple threats, multiple cues, simultaneously.

cues.description: Claw marks on bark to the left
Light is fading — dusk approaching rapidly

choices.text: Process each cue: smoke=fire(avoid), buzzing=bees(don't disturb), claws=bear territory(detour), dusk=wolves active(find safety now)

outcome.description: You parse the cues methodically. Detour south: avoids the smoke, bypasses the bee nest, exits bear territory, reaches open ground before full dark. Masterful recall under pressure.

memory_reward.title: Multi-Cue Navigation
memory_reward.description: Successfully processed smoke, bees, bear claw marks, and dusk timing simultaneously. Integrated memory knowledge under pressure.

choices.text: Pick the most obvious threat and react to that

outcome.description: You focus on one cue and ignore the others. You avoid the bear area but walk straight into the bee territory. Partial success, partial failure. Complex scenes need complex responses.

memory_reward.title: Tunnel Vision
memory_reward.description: Focusing on one threat caused me to ignore others. Complex scenes require reading all cues together.

encounters.title: The Most Dangerous Kind
encounters.description: A bear with cubs blocks your path. Your previous bear knowledge is relevant — but is it sufficient for this situation?
encounters.success_text: Your memory of cubs changes everything. Silent, fast retreat. She doesn't charge.
encounters.failure_text: You apply the wrong bear rules. Severe attack.
encounters.partial_text: You hesitate, apply a mix. Minor injury before escape.

encounters.title: Night Camp, No Fire
encounters.description: You're exhausted and need to sleep. No wood nearby for a fire. The howling starts shortly after you make camp.
encounters.success_text: You remember — fire is the key. You spend an hour finding wood. The fire holds all night. Wolves circle but don't enter.
encounters.failure_text: No fire, no protection. The wolves enter camp.
encounters.partial_text: You find some fuel but the fire is weak. Wolves approach but a torch keeps them back.

encounters.title: The Only Food Available
encounters.description: You haven't eaten in two days. In front of you are pale mushrooms. They look familiar — but are they the safe ones or the lookalikes?
encounters.success_text: Your refined memory guides you: check cap shape, smell, location. These are the safe variety. You eat carefully.
encounters.failure_text: You trusted a vague memory. These are the toxic lookalike. Severe illness.
encounters.partial_text: You eat cautiously, one piece. Minor stomach upset — wrong mushroom, but very little eaten.
